title: onepot
tagline: Onepot is a community savings app inspired by chit funds. Pool money and take larger payouts!
description:
OnePot is a modern group savings platform inspired by traditional chit funds, redesigned for the digital age. Users can log in with just their email and create or join groups of three types: Public groups (open to all), Private groups (invite-only via code), and Community groups (with membership verification). Every month, members contribute to a shared pot, and each takes a turn receiving the pooled funds. The first month’s contributions go to a secure treasury for added group confidence, while later payouts include an incentive for those who wait longer.

OnePot protects member privacy with no personal identity leaks and uses private transaction methods powered by Intmax, ensuring funds and member details stay confidential. With a friendly, community-centered experience, OnePot helps people save, support each other, and grow stronger together.
how_its_made:
Onepot is made using,

Supabase handles secure, scalable email-based authentication and manages user sessions, group memberships, contribution records, and payout schedules.

Intmax Layer 2 provides secure, privacy-preserving payment channels. This ensures user contributions and payouts remain confidential while still maintaining trustless settlement and transparency. Participants can fund and receive payouts off-chain, protecting their financial privacy and identities.

Flare anchors smart contract logic on-chain while verifying trusted external data sources. For example, it validates community memberships (like Telegram or Discord activity) so that only qualified users can join community-vetted groups. Flare's data attestation tools make sure group rules are enforced reliably and in a tamper-proof way.

Self Protocol enables decentralized human verification, confirming participants are real, unique humans (for example, verifying age or proof of personhood) without leaking personal data. This prevents bots and fake accounts from abusing the platform, increasing fairness and trust across all group types.
